text: HDAC inhibitors that restored NHE6 expression normalized the ApoE4-specific endosomal pH defect in astrocytes.
description: ApoE4 astrocytes treated with HDAC inhibitors; the specific drugs, doses and the astrocyte source are not given in the abstract (abstract-only). Caveat: a pharmacological reversal and possibly a non-human model.

provenance.excerpt: HDAC inhibitors that restored NHE6 expression normalized ApoE4-specific defects in endosomal pH, LRP1 trafficking, and amyloid clearance.

meccogFinding.summary: (HDAC inhibition in APOE4 astrocytes) -> (restored NHE6 expression) -> (normalized, less acidic endosomal pH)

perturbed.variable: HDAC inhibitor treatment of ApoE4 astrocytes (restores NHE6, reversing the putative APOE4 effect)
